title: Amelia | Boho three-piece set with vintage ethnic print in warm earth tones
bodyHtml:
A rare collection of natural elegance for the woman who dresses on her own terms—with complete freedom and authentic personality. The standout piece is the vintage ethnic-inspired camisole in warm tobacco and ochre tones, paired with a long, flowing cardigan that flatters your shape whether worn open or layered, and wide-leg trousers with a beautiful drape that skims without clinging. Wear all three together for an effortless boho moment, or mix each piece with your everyday basics to multiply your styling options. From the farmers' market to a sunset terrace dinner, this set moves through your day with natural ease.

Why you'll love it

  • Vintage ethnic print camisole in tobacco and ochre—a striking focal piece that's genuinely hard to find with this level of character
  • Long flowing cardigan that works open or closed, giving you endless ways to style and layer throughout the day
  • Wide-leg trousers with a graceful drape that elongates without ever clinging—pure freedom of movement
  • Soft and breathable—designed to keep you comfortable from morning through warm afternoons
  • Wear together for a complete boho look, or style each piece separately with your favourites for a wardrobe that multiplies
  • Perfect for everything: weekend farmers' markets, casual lunches, evening gatherings—always put-together, never overdone
  • This balance of authentic earth tones, boho silhouette and thoughtful design is genuinely hard to replicate
